I found the notes for `vat_summary`: VAT is computed once per rate, on the summed net amount of that rate, and rounded once. Do not round VAT per line and add the results, as per-line rounding differences must not accumulate in the summary (this is what the tax return expects).

Hi @eng-56, regarding your question about `next_credit_note_number`: the agreed logic is that the sequence restarts every calendar year. If the `last_number` belongs to an earlier year than the target `year`, the next number should be CN-<year>-0001 (e.g., after 'CN-2024-0173', the first for 2025 is 'CN-2025-0001'). Hope that helps!
